thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up — partner X launch + EoQ promo scheduled Tue 2026-11-24 09:00 PT. Risk: concurrent heavy embeddings + chat. Can infra run a short capacity sim and propose warmup & fallback plan? Need numbers (GPU hours, peak QPS, cost) by EOD today. :eyes:

josh: On it. I'll run the microburst sim against a 3-model mix (gpt-like-13B q4, 70B int8, embed-2). Estimating peak QPS ~1.6k for chat+embed bundle. Need to confirm request size distribution.

priya: I'll share the customer traffic trace (anonymized) — sending now.

priya: ```
./tools/trace-extract --range 2m --pattern "launch_promo" > traces/launch_promo.json
```

josh: Ran sim: `tools/capacity-sim --trace traces/launch_promo.json --gpus \"A100:80,H100:20\" --kv-warmup true --overprovision 0.3`

josh: sim summary: peak concurrent requests 1,720 QPS, avg tokens/s 48k, tail latency 95th=210ms. Required baseline capacity: 100 A100 equiv GPUs. With 30% buffer -> 130 A100 equiv -> mix could be 90 A100 + 20 H100.

anita: For pre-warm cost calc: post-warm steady-state extra GPU hours = 130 GPUs * 4 hours = 520 GPU-hours. At blended rate $3.8/hr -> ~$2,000 one-time pre-warm. If we keep reserve for 24h it's ~$12.5k/day.

marc: Suggest warmup steps: 1) pre-pull model shards to nodes 2) prepopulate KV cache for top 10k prefixes 3) enable short-lived overprovision autoscaling for 60m 4) activate cross-region spill to eu-west and us-west.

elaine: Good. What's the KV prepopulate plan size and time?

josh: KV prepopulate: ~1.8M tokens (top prefixes) -> takes ~12 minutes if we parallelize across 50 nodes. Command:

```bash
redwoodctl warmup --model gpt-like-13B --kv-file s3://warmups/launch_kv.ndjson --concurrency 50
```

devops-bot: Scheduled warmup job created: job/ww-1797770001-warmup. ETA start 2026-11-24T06:30:00Z

priya: Network note: eu-west has 2x less spare capacity in that window; recommend shifting 20% traffic to us-west and use model quantized variant for eu.

marc: Fallback policy: prefer model-quantized-13B-int8 in eu-west (saves ~40% GPU). Add automatic rollback if latency > 300ms for 3 consecutive minutes.

anita: Cost sensitivity: finance wants a cap at $15k/day for reserves. Current plan peak day estimate (24h reserve) = $12.5k + variable usage ~$6k -> $18.5k. If we reduce reserve to 8h -> ~$6k reserve + $6k variable = ~$12k/day.

sam: Proposal: run a 2-hour smoke with 30% overprovision starting T-3 hours. If metrics stable (95th < 250ms, error rate <0.5%) then scale down to 10% reserve. Rollout ops will be manual with on-call alerting.

elaine: OK sounds actionable. Deliverables: josh/priya run full sim and upload report + cost table; marc/anita draft warmup playbook with rollback steps; sam schedule smoke run. EOD check-in.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-11-24T05:00:00Z - 2026-11-24T10:00:00Z by ops-squad

marc: I added a canary route that sends 2% traffic to a separate pool with strict telemetry. If canary fails, traffic routes back within 90s.

elaine: Thanks team. @here please flag any blockers now. :pray:
